purpose: Real-data v4 baseline prepared so LBI can evaluate current conditions against quantitative history and separate nominal growth, real activity and price effects.

macro: Japan nominal GDP fiscal-year level: 2005FY-2025FY (2025FY preliminary)
2026-Q2 real/nominal GDP QoQ and seasonally adjusted annual-rate levels
industry_comparison: 16 SNA industries: nominal GDP share history 2019-2024
16 SNA industries: official current-price GDP levels for 2023 and 2024
16 SNA industries: 2024 nominal YoY derived from official current-price levels
16 SNA industries plus primary/secondary/tertiary aggregates: latest 2026-Q1 real seasonally adjusted QoQ momentum
Transport/postal linked to its SPPI price signal without treating price as physical volume
prices: Transport/postal SPPI and selected logistics services including road freight, ocean freight, international air freight, warehousing and 3PL
beauty_retail: Department-store total sales: calendar-year 2021-2025 and monthly 2026-01 to 2026-06
Department-store cosmetics sales: calendar-year 2021-2025 and monthly 2026-01 to 2026-06
Drugstore total and Beauty Care sales: calendar-year 2022-2025
Existing cosmetics shipment, household spend and category structure observations retained
Beauty real-demand proxy is intentionally not calculated until official cosmetics CPI history is seeded
trade: Existing 2026 monthly and H1 provisional trade observations retained

data_rules: Every percentage field states or implies an explicit comparison basis in the metric or field name; naked deltas are not used.
Nominal, real and price series are separate analytical axes. Values with different periods are not mechanically subtracted to create an inflation estimate.
JDSA store-count-adjusted YoY is stored separately as yoy_store_adjusted_pct and is not reconstructed from raw sales values.
GDP observations retain source vintage because GDP is revised retrospectively; a vintage change is not interpreted as an economic event.
Derived values such as annual trade balance and 2024 industry nominal YoY are explicitly derived from official published totals.
SPPI is a business-service transaction price index and is not treated as freight volume or an SNA deflator.
Historical baseline observations are context and confirmation layers, not Critical Radar events by themselves.
collector_backlog: Official 2025-base item-level CPI history for cosmetics small group 0150, required before Beauty nominal sales can be converted into a same-period real-demand proxy.
Production-side QNA nominal seasonally adjusted QoQ by industry, to provide same-period nominal-vs-real quarterly comparisons alongside the existing real QNA series.
Longer industry GDP deflator histories for direct annual price-effect decomposition by industry.
notes: This file is informational only and is not intended as a frontend dependency.
Production data lives in reports.json, critical-news.json, topic-intelligence.json, commerce-calendar.json and data/economy datasets.
All populated baseline items are based on publicly verified sources available at generation time; unavailable facts are not invented.
Empty series remain explicit backlog targets for future collectors rather than being filled with estimates.
